title: leucosinapis hispida
intro: Leucosinapis hispida, commonly known as wild mustard, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Leucosinapis hispida include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and expel mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of the plant include isothiocyanates, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
